events.title: Deep Dive: Talaka’s Two-Way Roguelike Progression System
events.summary: Hey everyone! Paulo from Potato Kid here, and today I’m bringing more details on one of the most complex systems in Talaka: the Two-Way Progression System.In many roguelites, new content is unlocked as you die. It seems natural, but it creates a curious situation: players who play well and go far in a Run take longer to unlock new features than players who die early. Skill ends up being punished with less content, and that doesn’t fit what we want for Talaka.This is not an easy problem to solve.
